name: InterContinental Lisbon
positioning: Contemporary city-centre hotel beside Eduardo VII Park, just above the Avenida da Liberdade, with views over the old town and the Tagus River
best_for: Travelers who want a central Lisbon base near Eduardo VII Park and the Avenida da Liberdade
Guests who want a suite or room with a private terrace and city views

facts.text: The hotel sits next to Eduardo VII Park, just above the Avenida da Liberdade.
The hotel has views over the old city and the Tagus River.
The hotel is in Lisbon's city centre, centrally located for visiting the capital's museums, monuments and castles.
Rooms and suites have natural light and modern decor in soft neutral tones, and overlook Eduardo VII Park, the historic old town and the Tagus River.
The suites include Two Storey Suites, one of them with a terrace.
Akla, the signature restaurant beside the lobby, has a modern design with Portuguese tiled panels and cooks with Portuguese seasonal ingredients under Chef Eddy Melo.
The Uptown Bar is a modern space with mirrored walls and mood lighting, serving drinks mixed with local artisanal products.
The InterContinental Club Lounge is a tranquil space with views of Lisbon.
The hotel has a valet parking service and welcomes pets.
The hotel's Incredible Occasions program helps guests celebrate a milestone birthday, a proposal or a dinner party.
The hotel is single-use plastic free.

highlights.text: The setting is next to Eduardo VII Park, the largest park in central Lisbon, a short stroll from the Avenida da Liberdade.
Rooms and suites with balconies sit on the upper floors, each with a private terrace looking over the city and the river.
The One Bedroom Suite with Terrace, on the 15th floor, has a terrace overlooking the city of Lisbon.
Rooms and suites look over Eduardo VII Park, the historic old town and the Tagus River.
At Akla, the signature restaurant, Chef Eddy Melo works with Portuguese seasonal ingredients in a room lined with Portuguese tiled panels.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may not suit guests seeking a quiet retreat.
